description: This file defines React components for the admin UI navigation menu, including navigation items, list, container, footer, and developer resources menu with dialog interactions.

methods.name: getHrefFromList
methods.description: Generates a URL path from a list metadata object, appending '/1' if the list is a singleton.

methods.name: NavItem
methods.description: A React component representing a navigation item linking to a specific page, with active state logic based on current route.

methods.name: NavList
methods.description: A wrapper component for the navigation list, applying accessibility and layout properties.

methods.name: NavContainer
methods.description: A layout component that stacks its children vertically for the navigation UI.

methods.name: Navigation
methods.description: The main navigation component that renders the navigation list and footer, dynamically including custom navigation if configured.

methods.name: NavFooter
methods.description: A footer container for additional navigation or links.

methods.name: DeveloperResourcesMenu
methods.description: A component providing a menu with developer resources, including links to API explorer, GitHub, documentation, and community, with a dialog for community info.
